from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company from a 10-Q filing, with units preserved for downstream normalization."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name")
    earnings_before_taxes: float = Field(description="Income before income taxes; negative if loss")
    earnings_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    tax_expense: float = Field(description="Income tax expense/provision; negative if benefit")
    tax_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale for tax expense: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    period: str = Field(description="The period covered, e.g., '2025-03'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_data: list[CompanyTaxData]
